output.summary: An evergreen shrub native to Mexico and Central America. It has a thick, often elephant-foot-like base and clumps of narrow, spineless leaves. In Central America, flower petals are eaten after the bitter anthers and ovaries are removed, then blanched and cooked; tender stem tips are eaten in El Salvador.
